summary: Micromem Technologies Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K furnishing an August 6, 2026 news release on commercialization progress of its gas sensing technology. The release details prototype development of wearable and fixed-position gas detection platforms, market estimates ($1.185B portable, $2.29B fixed) and a projected $50M annual initial opportunity. No special situation (merger, tender, activist, spin-off, etc.) is involved; it is a routine business update. The filing includes only forward-looking product development commentary and no transactional terms.
